signature: Cannot run target compiler|Maybe you forgot to setup the environment
root_cause: NATIVE_OHOS_SDK (or another toolchain path) contains a space; qmake's compiler probe builds an unquoted command line and the shell splits it
fix: use the space-free path env_probe.py writes into environment.tsv (ohos-sdk row: 8.3 short path or a junction); never hand-set NATIVE_OHOS_SDK in a plan

root_cause: Qt OHOS SDK host tools (moc/uic/rcc/qmake) are llvm-mingw builds and need its runtime DLLs (libc++.dll) on PATH; build tools started by hvigor/CMake do not inherit an interactive PATH fix
fix: env_probe.py adds the llvm-mingw bin directory to the command_env of environment.tsv (llvm-mingw row); batch_checks.py/hvigor_build.py apply it to every step. Never copy DLLs into the SDK (read-only)

signature: does not support using lazy import|10705000
root_cause: the template's ArkTS glue (OhosExportModules.ts) uses lazy import, which the GA es2abc configuration of compatibleSdkVersion 5.0.0(12) rejects
fix: add "compatibleSdkVersionStage": "beta3" to the product in the project build-profile.json5 (template_patch.py does it); never edit OhosExportModules.ts

root_cause: the hvigor daemon (on by default) runs every build after the first with the environment variables of that first build, so a PATH/NATIVE_OHOS_SDK fix from environment.tsv never reaches the build and the same error comes back; the daemon does not keep the caller waiting (measured 2026-10-31, hvigor 6.24.4)
fix: template_patch.py sets execution.daemon: false in hvigor/hvigor-config.json5; devecocli_build.py refuses a project without it and batch_checks.py refuses bare devecocli build/hvigor steps
source: repro 2026-10-31 (Windows, empty project); migration notepad-- PILOT-003

root_cause: a bottle extracted under the deep portgraph workspace path exceeds the Windows MAX_PATH limit
fix: run closure.py, which fetches into the short libs directory (environment.tsv host row path); or enable LongPathsEnabled

root_cause: a Python tool printed non-ASCII text to a GBK console
fix: set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 (environment.tsv python row sets it; closure.py and batch_checks.py apply it)

root_cause: qmake TEMPLATE=app becomes lib<TARGET>.so on OHOS only when ohos_deployment.prf runs, which needs a non-empty target.path; without it the app is linked as an executable the HAP cannot load
fix: in the ohos scope of the .pro set target.path = $$DESTDIR and INSTALLS += target (preflight_build_files.py flags it as PF-TARGET-PATH)

root_cause: a header listed in HEADERS (often through a *.h wildcard) declares a Q_OBJECT class whose members are never defined; moc emits its vtable and the OHOS link (-Wl,--no-undefined) fails, while desktop linkers drop it
fix: define the class or stop moc from seeing it in the ohos scope; HEADERS -= does not remove entries added by a wildcard (qmake expands it late), so list headers explicitly or fix the header (preflight_build_files.py flags PF-ORPHAN-QOBJECT)

root_cause: a HEADERS/SOURCES/FORMS wildcard matched nothing; qmake keeps the literal glob in the Makefile
fix: remove the empty wildcard or guard it in the ohos scope (preflight_build_files.py flags PF-EMPTY-GLOB)

root_cause: hvigor stages entry/libs/<abi> into stripped_native_libs and keeps only .so files, so runtime data placed there (themes, translations, config) never reaches the HAP
fix: ship runtime data under entry/src/main/resources/resfile/<dir> and locate it from the resource dir at runtime (QOhosAppContext resourceDir); hap_check.py reports dropped files

root_cause: the .pro requests a Qt module the Qt OHOS SDK does not ship
fix: drop or replace the module inside the ohos scope (QT -= <module>) after checking its real use; record a INV row (preflight_build_files.py flags PF-QT-MODULE)

root_cause: a unix scope adds OpenMP (-fopenmp/-lgomp) and the OHOS spec is also unix; the OHOS musl sysroot ships no libgomp
fix: guard host-only unix blocks with unix:!ohos and add an ohos scope (preflight_build_files.py flags PF-UNIX-LEAK)

root_cause: a library requested by LIBS is not available for OHOS (host path leaked from a unix scope, or a third-party library not cross-compiled yet)
fix: check unix-scope leaks (unix:!ohos) and the portgraph closure (closure.py) for the library; build vendored libraries as their own OHOS targets first

root_cause: QML type plugins are not deployed: find_package/target_link_libraries only deploy C++ libraries
fix: copy <Qt SDK>/qml into entry/src/main/resources/resfile/qml (KB semantic/qt-harmonyos-project-structure.md §7.4)

signature: spawn java ENOENT|java not found|hvigorw not found
root_cause: hvigor cannot find the DevEco JBR/node
fix: use environment.tsv (the jbr row puts DevEco jbr/bin on PATH, deveco sets DEVECO_HOME/DEVECO_SDK_HOME) through devecocli_build.py; devecocli runs hvigor with DevEco's bundled node

signature: Could not find a package configuration file provided by \"Qt5|Could NOT find Qt5
root_cause: the OHOS CMake toolchain sets CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PACKAGE=ONLY, so find_package ignores CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH
fix: switch CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PACKAGE to BOTH around find_package and pass -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=<Qt SDK> (template_patch.py sets the argument)

root_cause: the HAP is unsigned or its signing profile does not match the bundleName/device
fix: sign with the materials of the signing decision (devecocli signature generate) and keep AppScope bundleName equal to the profile's bundle name

root_cause: the Qt OHOS SDK's ohos_deployment.prf writes the openharmonydeployqt call into an @echo recipe (upstream QTFOROH-441/442), so make ohosdeploy only prints it; entry/libs stays empty and the HAP packs no app or Qt library
fix: do not use make ohosdeploy; deploy with deploy_qt_libs.py (runs openharmonydeployqt with the DT_NEEDED closure of the app library and copies third-party .so files); never edit the SDK prf

root_cause: openharmonydeployqt looks for <sdk-dir>/native/llvm/bin/llvm-readobj, so --sdk-dir (or OHOS_SDK_DIR) must be the OpenHarmony SDK root; a junction to the native dir alone breaks the prf's NATIVE_OHOS_SDK/.. parent
fix: rerun env_probe.py (it writes a space-free OHOS_SDK_DIR whose native child is NATIVE_OHOS_SDK) and deploy with deploy_qt_libs.py

root_cause: make relinks only when an object is newer than the target; a changed .pro/.pri (LIBS, static vs shared) leaves the old .so in place, so the next package step ships the stale library with its old DT_NEEDED
fix: deploy_qt_libs.py refuses a library older than its build files; delete the .so (or touch a source) and rebuild before deploying

signature: 10106102|screen is locked during the application launch|\[KI-022\]
root_cause: launching an ability while the device screen is locked fails (10106102), and developer mode does not unlock it automatically; the install succeeded
fix: the user unlocks the device (developer mode stays on) and the device step is rerun (device_run.py reports it). Do the work that needs no device first, ask once at the end

root_cause: a qmake scope condition stands alone on its line and its '{' is on the next line: qmake evaluates the condition, discards the result and opens an unconditional block, so host-only LIBS/PRE_TARGETDEPS/paths inside it reach the OHOS Makefile
fix: write the brace on the condition line ('unix:!ohos {', not 'unix:!ohos' then '{'); preflight_build_files.py flags PF-SCOPE-BRACE
